title: Forge Node Query Result
description: Response payload for the history.query / session.query / state.query node commands. `items` shape depends on `kind`: for 'history' each item is a raw log or event entry, for 'session' each item conforms to project/session.schema.json, for 'state' the single item is a node-state.schema.json snapshot.

total.description: Total matching items server-side, independent of how many are returned in this page.
